content.short: CitaDelv is a decentralized game creation platform and story driven metaverse with crypto based incentives for both game creators and players.
content.description:
CitaDelv is a Massive Multiplayer Metaverse utilizing VR and blockchain technologies through which users can create, own, and share digital content. The immersive realm includes both quest lines and open world exploration while also providing incentives for players to build and share their own games with the community.

Through the Profusion SDK game creators are rewarded based on the number of players their game attracts, while players are rewarded for playing. With desktop, VR, and mobile capabilities CitaDelv orients its content creation around the crypto movement’s central philosophy: remove power from central authorities and return it to individual participants.
